Subject: Would you share your perspective at the local event?

Hi [Name],

Would you consider volunteering as a guest speaker at the upcoming local event? Your thoughtful perspective could help someone see things differently—and hearing an honest personal story can make people feel less alone.

I know public speaking isn’t your favorite. We could ask the organizers about a short talk or a seated Q&A, with notes to keep things comfortable. I’d happily help you prepare and practice, so it wouldn’t become a huge time commitment.

You wouldn’t have to share anything too personal or deliver a flawless performance. A few useful insights could make a real difference.

Would you be open to finding out what’s involved before deciding?

[Your Name]
question: Write a persuasive email to convince your introverted friend, who dislikes public speaking, to volunteer as a guest speaker at a local event. Use compelling arguments and address potential objections. Please be concise.
